note: Point 1 of AR-y-194: word_negative_controls (the ten new controls, one per widened word or root, and the six r18 controls) and the population are committed ALONE before the rule changes in template_reader.py. The population is constructed and synthetic (no real-use header is in the repository, as the r13, r16, r17 and r18 records state). identifier_forms carries the r18 forms and the eight S31 forms the cell names; count_forms, attribute_forms and not_account_forms carry the r18 forms, and every seed the check names is present.

negative_control_roles.Roth IRA Balance: roth ira as a two-word modifier, with an attribute after it (no account word)
negative_control_roles.Trust Name: trust as a modifier, with no account word after it
negative_control_roles.Portfolio Numbers: numbers as a plural tail, with no account word
negative_control_roles.Sleeve Nos: nos as a tail, with no account word
negative_control_roles.Model Seqno: seqno as a tail, with no account word
negative_control_roles.Model Serial: serial as a tail, with no account word
negative_control_roles.Accnt Holder: accnt as an account word, followed by an attribute word
negative_control_roles.Subaccounts Value: subaccounts as an account word, followed by an attribute word
negative_control_roles.Acct Name: a header with an account ROOT (acct) whose values are names, not identifiers
negative_control_roles.No. of Accounts: a count-like header: a plural count of accounts, excluded from the header rule
